verdict.rationale: GlitchTip documents a programmatic surface: it aims to be Sentry API compatible, and a token-authenticated CLI handles releases, deploys, source maps and debug files. A built-in MCP server also lets AI tools browse, inspect and resolve issues and search logs. Nothing in the evidence says the API matches the UI, though. Setup flows like creating organizations, teams, projects and alert recipients are documented only as UI steps, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: explicit API-UI parity statement, documented API reference/OpenAPI spec, API coverage of org/team/project/alert administration, independent corroboration.
